en-US.name: Tend: A Little Room to Think
en-US.subtitle: Focus, question, reflect
en-US.promotionalText: A little daily thinking practice: examine assumptions, compare explanations, and put an idea in your own words. Focus when you want; return at your pace.
en-US.description:
A little room to think.

Tend brings focused work and short thinking practice into one quiet pixel room. Start with a question, give it some attention, and leave yourself a useful place to return.

LOOK TWICE
Everyday situations can invite several explanations. Separate what was observed from what was inferred, consider another explanation, and ask what evidence would change your mind. Each case is authored, with progressive hints, an explanation and a related variation. Personal notes stay on your device.

THINK THROUGH ONE IDEA
One daily invitation alternates between physics and Look Twice. Physics questions connect ideas about forces, pressure, buoyancy, energy and equilibrium. Make an initial prediction, check the assumptions, and keep or revise it. Hints open one at a time. Explore the step-by-step explanation, why alternatives can seem plausible, and when the answer would change. Source links and an optional variation help you follow the principle further. Simple introductions are available whenever you want them.

EXPLAIN IT BACK
After an explanation, optionally put the idea in your own words. Notice what you can explain and what still needs another look. Related reviews return a few days after completing a daily idea. Your notebook keeps concepts explored and reviewed. Reasoning has no timer, leaderboard, intelligence rating or streak to lose.

FOCUS AND LEAVE A THREAD
Begin a focus session with one question or task. Choose 15/3, 25/5, 50/10, or your own intervals. Park distractions without leaving your question. End with optional notes on what you learned, where you are stuck and your next small action. That next action is ready when you return. Export weekly notes or keep a full backup.

YOUR SESSION, ON THE LOCK SCREEN
Your question, pixel tomato and countdown stay on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Pause and Done. Leave a note from the end-of-session notification. Optional Screen Time app blocking keeps chosen apps behind a Tend screen during focus sessions. Start with Siri, Shortcuts or the Action Button, or use a quick timer between sets.

WARM UP OR REST
Optional attention tasks include tracking moving tomatoes, responding to the ripe ones, finding a middle arrow, naming ink colours, remembering locations and estimating time. These exercises keep their own bests and streaks. During breaks, try gentle breathing, look far away, or write down one good thing from today.

YOURS, ON YOUR DEVICE
The interface, content and fonts are bundled offline. No account, ads, analytics or AI service. Predictions, thinking notes and your work notebook remain on your device until you choose to export them. Your question is visible on the Lock Screen while focusing; notifications never show your notes.

Tend offers practice with particular tasks and thinking habits. It does not measure intelligence or promise general cognitive improvement. Timer minutes record elapsed sessions, not attention or research quality. Tend is independently developed by Houfu Chen and is not affiliated with the authors it cites.

reviewNotes:
No account, login, server or sample credentials are needed. All content and core functionality are bundled offline.

On Focus, scroll below the timer and intention cards to the reasoning activity. The reasoning desk offers daily conceptual physics and Look Twice, everyday cases about observations, interpretations and alternative explanations. Record a prediction and optional reason, consider assumptions, keep or revise it, and open hints individually or explicitly reveal. Read the authored explanation and alternative feedback, then mark it explored. Try the optional variation and Explain it back prompt. Related reviews return a few local calendar days later. Reasoning is unscored and untimed; it is not a health or intelligence assessment.

The focus timer, notebook, optional local notifications, Siri/Shortcuts, Lock Screen Live Activity, Screen Time app blocking, attention warm-ups and rest tools remain available. All personal notes and activity progress stay in app-local storage; Settings exports/restores a user-directed backup. Source links open externally. No AI, analytics, advertising or account service is used.
